description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin class 'Term' for migrating taxonomy terms from the database. It includes methods for querying taxonomy data, preparing source rows with language and hierarchy information, and exposing the term ID as a unique identifier.

classes.name: Term
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for taxonomy terms, providing methods to query, process, and prepare taxonomy term data for migration.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to retrieve taxonomy term data, optionally filtered by vocabulary (bundle).

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array describing the fields available in the source data, such as term ID, name, description, weight, parent, and format.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each source row by adding language information, hierarchy (parents), and handling field values and title module replacements.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Defines the unique identifier for each taxonomy term as 'tid' of type integer.
